items.docs: Retrieves available appointment timeslots for specified vaccines at Walgreens locations near a given zip code and coordinates. Returns locations with their available dates and time slots, vaccine product information, and distance from the specified position.

Reserves a specific vaccine appointment timeslot at a Walgreens location, returning an engagement ID for use in subsequent patient registration and confirmation steps. The hold is temporary and must be confirmed to finalize the booking.

Finalizes a vaccine appointment reservation, converting the held timeslot into a confirmed booking. Must be called after patient information has been attached to the engagement. Returns HTTP 204 on success.
